title: Godfather Multi-Channel Visual Distribution Plan
description: Standardized JSON Schema for orchestrating asset distribution across Pinterest, Imgur, and Tumblr in a single coordinated 'plan'. Used by the DistributionEngine.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier for this plan. Generated as `plan_<timestamp>_<slug>` if omitted.

version.description: Schema version this plan adheres to.

niche_id.description: Identifier of the niche this plan belongs to (mirrors niche.config.ts id).

execution_mode.description: dry_run: validate & log, no API calls. queue: stage on platform queues. live: publish immediately.

asset_package.description: The raw photo/poster + metadata that will be distributed.

title.description: Master title — used as fallback for platform-specific titles.

guide_content.description: Long-form how-to/guide body content, used for Tumblr NPF + descriptions.

summary.description: Short marketing description, used as fallback for Pinterest/Imgur descriptions.

source.description: Path or URL of the local image. Local paths must exist on disk; URLs are downloaded.

canonical_source_url.description: The authoritative URL on YOUR site. Used for backlinks and SEO attribution.

tags.description: Master tag list — platforms will subset/transform as needed.

keywords.description: SEO target keywords — fed into auto-tag generation.

platform_routes.description: Per-platform routing instructions. Omit a platform key to skip it.

board_id.description: Pinterest Board ID (NOT the board name). Use board lookup helper to resolve.

pin_title.description: Pinterest pin title. Falls back to asset_package.title.

pin_description.description: Pin description. Falls back to asset_package.summary.

destination_link.description: URL the pin links to when clicked. Falls back to canonical_source_url.

media_source_override.description: If 'imgur', uses the Imgur upload result URL as media source (interlinking).

album_id.description: Existing Imgur album to upload into. If null and create_album_if_missing is true, a new album is created.

include_source_attribution.description: Append canonical_source_url to image description for cross-platform reference.

post_format.description: photo: legacy photo post. npf: Newton Post Format (recommended). text: text-only with embedded image.

post_title.description: Title for NPF/text posts (Tumblr photo posts have no title).

caption_html.description: Rich HTML caption for legacy photo posts. NPF auto-generates from guide_content.

click_through_url.description: URL the IMAGE itself links to when clicked. Critical for 'how-to' posters acting as CTA buttons.

source_url.description: Tumblr's official 'source' attribution field — appears at bottom of post for SEO backlink.

tags.description: Tumblr tags (no '#' prefix). SEO-optimized; max 30 — first 5 are most important.

custom_url_slug.description: Custom slug for the post URL (lowercase, hyphenated).

publish_on.description: Schedule post for future date (state must be 'queue').

interlinking_logic.description: Defines how the three platforms reference each other after upload.

primary_host.description: Which upload result becomes the canonical image URL referenced by the other platforms.

cross_reference_in_descriptions.description: If true, each platform's description includes a 'See also on [other platforms]' line.

execution_order.description: Order of platform execution. Imgur first by default so its URL is available for interlinking.

fail_fast.description: If true, abort entire plan on first platform failure.
